wants.topic: The 'Untold' or 'Hidden' Truths of Civil Rights Leaders
wants.evidence: AllThingsAfro's best performing videos (Malcolm X, Fred Hampton) focus on correcting mainstream narratives and exposing FBI/government interference.
Ethos's best performing content is consistently the 50-minute historical deep-dives (Crusades, Jerusalem, Vikings).

wants.topic: Humanizing historical figures beyond their stereotypes
wants.evidence: Comments on AllThingsAfro videos show high engagement with the 'real' Malcolm X vs the 'violent' stereotype.
Ethos's Jerusalem video comments show high interest in the intersection of faith, trade, and political power.

gaps: Nuanced, non-biased accounts of the Crusades that acknowledge both Western and Eastern perspectives without 'baby music' or distracting production choices.
Accurate timelines and scrolling visual aids in long-form historical documentaries.
Detailed analysis of how modern government institutions (FBI/CIA) specifically dismantled grassroots movements in the 1960s.
saturated: Biased, one-sided portrayals of religious wars.
High-level summaries of MLK that stick to the standard 'I Have a Dream' school-textbook narrative.
